intro: A fictional settings study that demonstrates every choice-kit control by example. Change anything, then press **Copy** and paste the JSON back. Turn on **Feedback mode** to annotate any block instead of changing it.

sections.body:
The reading surface restyles itself around two picks.

- **Dark mode** trades contrast for comfort at night
- Layout density decides how much fits on one screen

Both controls live right here, next to the text they govern — and again in the summary at the end, bound to the same value, so changing either one changes both.

sections.body:
Long-form text stays readable when the type size and the line spacing fit the reader. This whole section carries a feedback label: in Feedback mode, clicking any unlabelled part of it resolves to this section.

The **line spacing** pick exists only in this section — its summary row shows the current value and a jump link instead of a second control.
